bead.title: claude-tui/step4: JSONL transcript parsing seam (Stop-hook payload + ~/.claude/projects/ tailing)
bead.description:
Per ADR-013 design constraint #2 + the prior-art survey (claude-p, shannon): the parsing seam is the on-disk JSONL transcript at ~/.claude/projects/<workdir>/<id>.jsonl, NOT rendered TUI output. internal/pty/terminal is not required for Execute.

WORK:
- Register SessionStart + Stop hooks via --settings '<inline-json>' carve-out (the only flag allowed besides binary name).
- Read transcript path from the Stop-hook payload; tail the JSONL during the turn for streaming and read the final state at Stop.
- Translate JSONL entries to canonical service Events (text deltas, tool_call, tool_result, final with FinalData).
- Hook conflict handling per ADR-013 §7: detect existing user ~/.claude/settings.json hooks; either compose (preferred) or surface a structured warning if merge semantics aren't preservable.

NON-SCOPE: PreToolUse/PostToolUse for streaming progress (sub-bead step 5 covers if needed).
bead.acceptance:
1) claude-tui Runner.Execute registers SessionStart + Stop + PreToolUse + PostToolUse hooks via --settings inline JSON.
2) Stop-hook payload yields the JSONL transcript path; the runner reads it and emits canonical Events.
3) Intermediate ProgressEvents: PreToolUse fires a tool_call event with tool name + inputs; PostToolUse fires a tool_result event with outputs. Asserted by a turn-level test using a prompt that triggers a tool use; the event sequence contains at least one tool_call before Final.
4) Final event matches the existing claude harness's FinalData schema (tested by structural comparison against a recorded claude --print final event from cassette).
5) Event sequence-number ordering: every emitted event carries a monotonically increasing seq number; verified by a multi-event integration test.
6) Multi-turn replay safety: when /clear leaves a transcript file with prior turns, the runner reads only entries newer than the last-processed marker (tracked per session). Asserted by a test that pre-seeds a transcript file with two completed turns and verifies only the third turn's events are emitted.
7) Malformed JSONL handling: lines that fail to parse are logged (structured) and skipped without aborting the turn; the next valid line is processed. Tested by injecting a malformed line mid-stream.
8) Partial-write race: the tailer handles partially-written lines (no trailing newline yet) by waiting/retrying rather than parsing-and-failing. Tested by writing a partial line, sleeping briefly, then completing it.
9) Hook conflict path: if user already has SessionStart/Stop/PreToolUse/PostToolUse hooks defined in ~/.claude/settings.json, the runner either composes correctly (preferred) or emits a structured warning event explaining the unsupported configuration; tested both branches.
10) Fuzz test (testing.F): FuzzParseTranscriptLine in stream_test.go fuzzes the JSONL line parser; corpus seeded with malformed/edge-case inputs; runs at least 5 seconds in -short mode.
11) Property test (rapid): TestTranscriptLineRoundTrip asserts canonical event -> JSONL -> canonical event round-trips for randomly generated event values; integrated with the existing internal/session/property_test.go style.
12) go test ./internal/harnesses/claude-tui/... -count=1 green.
